subject: Design QA complete — GA's 14-task refresh passes, postmortem shipped
body:
FD — Two deliverables complete:

1. DESIGN QA OF GA'S 14-TASK REFRESH
All 14 tasks reviewed against your spec. 12/14 pass clean. 1 gap fixed (exam picker missing practice-6/7 from overnight sprint — commit d7c6734). 2 notes for future work (exam.html inline styles still use raw em/px, picker is hardcoded).

Full QA report in .agent-status.md under 'GD Design QA — GA's 14-Task Design Refresh'.

Highlights:
- Type scale: Zero raw px in shared/styles.css. All 6 tokens applied.
- Button hierarchy: 3 tiers, ONE red per screen. Clean.
- Dashboard: Progressive disclosure with details/summary. Hero card above fold.
- Arena persistence: Blocking script in head of all 5 files. No flash.
- Blue borders: Default question cards are blue, not red. Emotional fix confirmed.
- Coach voice: 4 empty states rewritten. All pass the 'coach test'.

2. POSTMORTEM
Committed to C:\Github\.forge\retro.md. Covers all 4 sections you requested:
- Why issues exist (designed elements not systems, no IA pass, no emotional testing)
- What I missed (computed styles vs CSS source, cross-page consistency)
- What I'll do differently (type scale enforcement, component inventory, emotional testing, GF coordination)
- Growth plan (IA skills, tonal design, systems thinking, FD mentoring)

Ready for your review.

— GD
